from solution import sum_range_list


def test_issue_example():
    """Example sum_range_list([2,1,5,6,8,3,4,9,10,11,8,12],8,10)==29."""
    result = sum_range_list([2, 1, 5, 6, 8, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 8, 12], 8, 10)
    # 10+11+8 = 29
    assert result == 29


def test_issue_full_list():
    """Sum between indices of specified range covers the whole list when m=0 and n=last."""
    result = sum_range_list([2, 1, 5, 6, 8, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 8, 12], 0, 11)
    # 2+1+5+6+8+3+4+9+10+11+8+12 = 79
    assert result == 79


def test_issue_single_index():
    """Sum between indices of specified range with m==n is the single element."""
    result = sum_range_list([2, 1, 5, 6, 8, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 8, 12], 3, 3)
    # element at index 3 is 6
    assert result == 6


def test_issue_range_from_zero():
    """Sum between indices starting at 0 includes the first element."""
    result = sum_range_list([2, 1, 5, 6, 8, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 8, 12], 0, 2)
    # 2+1+5 = 8
    assert result == 8


def test_issue_range_to_last():
    """Sum between indices ending at the last index includes the final element."""
    result = sum_range_list([2, 1, 5, 6, 8, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 8, 12], 9, 11)
    # 11+8+12 = 31
    assert result == 31


def test_issue_two_element_range():
    """Sum between two adjacent indices adds exactly those two numbers."""
    result = sum_range_list([2, 1, 5, 6, 8, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 8, 12], 4, 5)
    # 8+3 = 11
    assert result == 11


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Sum between indices of specified range handles negative numbers."""
    result = sum_range_list([-4, 7, -2, 5], 1, 2)
    # 7+(-2) = 5
    assert result == 5


def test_issue_single_element_list():
    """Sum between indices 0 and 0 of a one-element list is that element."""
    result = sum_range_list([42], 0, 0)
    # 42 = 42
    assert result == 42


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface solution.sum_range_list must be callable."""
    assert callable(sum_range_list)


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Sum of ints between indices must be returned as an int."""
    result = sum_range_list([1, 2, 3, 4], 0, 3)
    # 1+2+3+4 = 10
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_leaves_input_unchanged():
    """Public function must not mutate the input list."""
    data = [2, 1, 5, 6]
    snapshot = [2, 1, 5, 6]
    sum_range_list(data, 1, 2)
    assert data == snapshot
